name: Phishing (pre-engagement support)
description: Phishing has a direct role in physical engagements as a preparatory tactic. A well-timed phishing campaign can harvest credentials for use in physical access scenarios, establish a false digital presence that supports an in-person pretext, or deliver a payload that arms a later hardware implant phase. Phishing for physical engagements is always conducted under the same written authorization as the physical work.

blue.det: Email gateway alerts on suspicious links or attachments; user reports phishing email; SIEM alert on credential submission to lookalike domain; endpoint alert on payload execution.
blue.cm: Email gateway with link scanning and sandboxing; DMARC/DKIM/SPF enforcement; phishing simulation training; MFA preventing credential replay even after successful phish; DNS filtering blocking lookalike domains.
